items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: And then we were joined by John VonBergen... So we had a bass player. When Larry left we had John VonBergen.

ctx.x: That’s cool. Now the Alumni All-Stars, is there an official first year of their existence?

I don’t think there’s a definitive year. It’s the early fifties. I was the first drummer in the Alumni All-Stars because Paul Parker needed a drummer and he asked me. I was in the Catatonic Five. So he knew I was a drummer. And he said, “Come on, we’re going to play the same kind of music.” And he had his son, Mike Parker, playing cornet, and another son, Larry, playing bass. And then we were joined by John VonBergen, remember John?
